title: Keep product context available while investigating a change
statement: As a reviewer, I can open the Saga in current-state or comparison mode, so that I can keep product context available while investigating a change.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Current-state mode shows the active product documentation.
Current-state mode marks stale code links as health warnings.
Comparison mode emphasizes changed and affected documentation and code.
Comparison mode keeps unchanged product context reachable.
Documentation pages omit approval and comment controls.
A review shows its unexplained changed lines beside the review deck.
